name: sampling_plan
description: Survey sample sizes: how many respondents to estimate a proportion or a mean to a given margin of error and confidence, with the finite-population correction, a design effect and the expected response rate; and the split of a total sample across strata by proportional, Neyman or equal allocation, rounded to add up. Plus or minus 5 points at 95 % is 385.

margin.description: Margin of error: a proportion (0.05) for proportion, data units for mean

z.description: Fixed z instead of the normal quantile of confidence, e.g. 1.96

population.description: Population size for the finite-population correction

catalog.source: W. G. Cochran, Sampling Techniques, 3rd ed. (1977), ch. 4 (sample size, finite-population correction) and ch. 5 (Neyman allocation); checked against the table of R. V. Krejcie and D. W. Morgan, Educational and Psychological Measurement 30 (1970)
